mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.0%, the market anticipates prolonged high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (when industrial production is above 105), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing weakness reduces corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.0 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector is a key component of consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1600.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 650,000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the consumer sector drives economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 650,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment levels (PAYEMS) fall below 150,000 thousand and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, the market anticipates a recession due to labor market weakness and restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS < 150.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 285.0), a further rise in CPIAUCSL above 285.0 signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed delays rate cuts and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 285.0 and CPIAUCSL rises above 285.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
